lines.zh: 你把杂志那篇看完了吗？
lines.py: nǐ bǎ zá zhì nà piān kàn wán le ma ?
lines.en: Have you finished that magazine article?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看了，标题说图书馆把夜晚还给读者。
lines.py: kàn le , biāo tí shuō tú shū guǎn bǎ yè wǎn huán gěi dú zhě .
lines.en: Yes. The headline says the library gives the night back to readers.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那今晚能去借书？
lines.py: nà jīn wǎn néng qù jiè shū ?
lines.en: Can we borrow books tonight then?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先别急，文章后面说夜里只开一楼。
lines.py: xiān bié jí , wén zhāng hòu miàn shuō yè lǐ zhǐ kāi yī lóu .
lines.en: Hold on—the article later says only the ground floor opens at night.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 借书柜台不是也在一楼？
lines.py: jiè shū guì tái bù shì yě zài yī lóu ?
lines.en: Isn't the lending counter there too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 在，但夜间只办活动，不办借书。
lines.py: zài , dàn yè jiān zhǐ bàn huó dòng , bù bàn jiè shū .
lines.en: Yes, but evenings are for events, not borrowing.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这标题把我带远了。
lines.py: zhè biāo tí bǎ wǒ dài yuǎn le .
lines.en: That headline led me a bit far.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 所以我让你看完嘛。
lines.py: suǒ yǐ wǒ ràng nǐ kàn wán ma .
lines.en: That's why I told you to finish it.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 六十四个人来过，听着不少。
lines.py: liù shí sì gè rén lái guò , tīng zhe bù shǎo .
lines.en: Sixty-four people visited—that sounds like quite a few.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 六十四次，不是六十四个人。有的人每周都来。
lines.py: liù shí sì cì , bù shì liù shí sì gè rén . yǒu de rén měi zhōu dōu lái .
lines.en: Sixty-four visits, not people. Some came every week.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那有没有单独的人数？
lines.py: nà yǒu méi yǒu dān dú de rén shù ?
lines.en: Is there a separate count of people?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有，至少这篇没给。
lines.py: méi yǒu , zhì shǎo zhè piān méi gěi .
lines.en: No, at least not in this article.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你都看到哪了？
lines.py: nǐ dōu kàn dào nǎ le ?
lines.en: How far did you get?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 最后一段。还写了收椅子的安排。
lines.py: zuì hòu yī duàn . hái xiě le shōu yǐ zi de ān pái .
lines.en: The final paragraph. It even describes putting chairs away.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你现在连椅子都查？
lines.py: nǐ xiàn zài lián yǐ zi dōu chá ?
lines.en: You're checking chairs now too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不是查，是看散场以后谁留下收。
lines.py: bù shì chá , shì kàn sàn chǎng yǐ hòu shéi liú xià shōu .
lines.en: Not checking them—seeing who stays to put them away afterwards.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 通知写八点结束，八点半清场。
lines.py: tōng zhī xiě bā diǎn jié shù , bā diǎn bàn qīng chǎng .
lines.en: The notice says finish at eight, clear the room by eight thirty.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，文章讲故事，通知给实际安排。
lines.py: duì , wén zhāng jiǎng gù shì , tōng zhī gěi shí jì ān pái .
lines.en: Right. The article tells the story; the notice gives practical arrangements.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我想参加下周那场，先报名？

lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，二十个名额，周五前回复。
lines.py: hǎo , èr shí gè míng é , zhōu wǔ qián huí fù .

lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 要带一本书吗？

lines.py: kě yǐ dài , yě kě yǐ zhǐ tīng . jiè shū děi bái tiān lái .
lines.en: You can bring one or just listen. Borrowing needs a daytime visit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，那下周先听。我的书先不用跟着加班。
lines.py: xíng , nà xià zhōu xiān tīng . wǒ de shū xiān bù yòng gēn zhe jiā bān .
lines.en: Okay, I'll listen next week. My book needn't work overtime with me yet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你把卡带着，下次白天就能借。
lines.py: nǐ bǎ kǎ dài zhe , xià cì bái tiān jiù néng jiè .
lines.en: Keep your card with you so you can borrow next time during the day.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 每到周四晚上，社区图书馆一楼的灯会比平时多亮两个小时。白天经过那里的人，常以为六点以后门就锁了；现在有人下班吃过饭，又拿着一本薄书走进来。活动不是正式的课，也不要求读者准备长篇介绍。桌上有热水，椅子围成半圈，先由两个人读一小段，再让愿意的人接着说。有人每周都来，有人只是等附近演出开场时进来坐一会儿。灯亮起来，首先改变的是这几种普通的经过方式。
lines.py: měi dào zhōu sì wǎn shang , shè qū tú shū guǎn yī lóu de dēng huì bǐ píng shí duō liàng liǎng gè xiǎo shí . bái tiān jīng guò nà lǐ de rén , cháng yǐ wéi liù diǎn yǐ hòu mén jiù suǒ le ; xiàn zài yǒu rén xià bān chī guò fàn , yòu ná zhe yī běn báo shū zǒu jìn lái . huó dòng bù shì zhèng shì de kè , yě bú yào qiú dú zhě zhǔn bèi zhǎng piān jiè shào . zhuō shàng yǒu rè shuǐ , yǐ zi wéi chéng bàn quān , xiān yóu liǎng gè rén dú yī xiǎo duàn , zài ràng yuàn yì de rén jiē zhe shuō . yǒu rén měi zhōu dōu lái , yǒu rén zhǐ shì děng fù jìn yǎn chū kāi chǎng shí jìn lái zuò yī huì er . dēng liàng qǐ lái , shǒu xiān gǎi biàn de shì zhè jǐ zhǒng pǔ tōng de jīng guò fāng shì .
lines.en: Each Thursday the neighbourhood library's ground floor stays lit two hours longer. People who thought it closed at six now come after dinner with a slim book. It isn't a formal class or a long prepared presentation. There is hot water and a semicircle of chairs. Two readers read a passage, then others may speak. Some come weekly; others wait for a nearby performance. The lights first change these ordinary ways of passing through.

lines.zh: 这个尝试由两位常来的读者发起，馆员帮他们申请场地。原来的想法很简单：白天忙的人也能有个地方见面谈书。为了不打乱常规服务，借书柜台仍按六点结束办理，夜间只开一楼的活动区域，二楼不开放。第一阶段安排四个周四，结束后再根据值班、参加情况和反馈决定下一步。有人问能不能每天都开到八点，馆员说现在的人手只能支持这四次，不能把一个小范围试点写成已经开始的长期服务。
lines.py: zhè gè cháng shì yóu liǎng wèi cháng lái de dú zhě fā qǐ , guǎn yuán bāng tā men shēn qǐng chǎng dì . yuán lái de xiǎng fǎ hěn jiǎn dān : bái tiān máng de rén yě néng yǒu gè dì fāng jiàn miàn tán shū . wèi le bù dǎ luàn cháng guī fú wù , jiè shū guì tái réng àn liù diǎn jié shù bàn lǐ , yè jiān zhǐ kāi yī lóu de huó dòng qū yù , èr lóu bù kāi fàng . dì yī jiē duàn ān pái sì gè zhōu sì , jié shù hòu zài gēn jù zhí bān , cān jiā qíng kuàng hé fǎn kuì jué dìng xià yī bù . yǒu rén wèn néng bù néng měi tiān dōu kāi dào bā diǎn , guǎn yuán shuō xiàn zài de rén shǒu zhǐ néng zhī chí zhè sì cì , bù néng bǎ yī gè xiǎo fàn wéi shì diǎn xiě chéng yǐ jīng kāi shǐ de cháng qī fú wù .
lines.en: Two regular readers initiated the trial and librarians helped apply for space. The aim was a place for busy daytime workers to discuss books. Normal lending still ends at six; only the ground-floor activity area opens in the evening. Four Thursdays form the initial trial, followed by review of staffing, participation and feedback. Current staffing supports those four evenings, not daily long-term opening.

lines.zh: 四次活动结束，到访记录分别是十八、二十、十二和十四次，共六十四次。这里记录的是每次走进活动区的人次，不是去掉重复以后的六十四位居民。前两次正好遇到附近有演出，有几个人听一小段就离开；第三次下雨，也有人提前发消息说不方便来。组织者没有把每一种变化都归到读书内容上。大家更关心留下的人能不能听清、椅子够不够，以及八点结束时还有没有人临时才知道不能借书。
lines.py: sì cì huó dòng jié shù , dào fǎng jì lù fēn bié shì shí bā , èr shí , shí èr hé shí sì cì , gòng liù shí sì cì . zhè lǐ jì lù de shì měi cì zǒu jìn huó dòng qū de rén cì , bù shì qù diào chóng fù yǐ hòu de liù shí sì wèi jū mín . qián liǎng cì zhèng hǎo yù dào fù jìn yǒu yǎn chū , yǒu jǐ gè rén tīng yī xiǎo duàn jiù lí kāi ; dì sān cì xià yǔ , yě yǒu rén tí qián fā xiāo xī shuō bù fāng biàn lái . zǔ zhī zhě méi yǒu bǎ měi yī zhǒng biàn huà dōu guī dào dú shū nèi róng shàng . dà jiā gèng guān xīn liú xià de rén néng bù néng tīng qīng , yǐ zi gòu bù gòu , yǐ jí bā diǎn jié shù shí hái yǒu méi yǒu rén lín shí cái zhī dào bù néng jiè shū .
lines.en: The four visit counts were eighteen, twenty, twelve and fourteen, totalling sixty-four visits rather than sixty-four unique residents. The first two coincided with nearby performances; some left shortly. Rain affected the third. Organisers didn't assign every change to reading content. They cared about audibility, seating and whether anyone learned only at eight that lending was unavailable.

lines.zh: 第一次的通知没有把最后一点写醒目。有位读者带着想借的书名赶来，等讨论结束才发现柜台已经下班。他没有责怪读书的人，只问为什么亮着灯却不能借。馆员解释白天服务和晚间活动的人员安排不同，随后把借书时间加到入口的纸上，也放进报名回复里。第二次仍有一个人看漏了，但他进门就问清，决定先留下听，下周白天再来办理。修改一张通知没让问题马上消失，却减少了把期待一路带到散场才落空的情况。
lines.py: dì yī cì de tōng zhī méi yǒu bǎ zuì hòu yī diǎn xiě xǐng mù . yǒu wèi dú zhě dài zhuó xiǎng jiè de shū míng gǎn lái , děng tǎo lùn jié shù cái fā xiàn guì tái yǐ jīng xià bān . tā méi yǒu zé guài dú shū de rén , zhǐ wèn wèi shén me liàng zhe dēng què bù néng jiè . guǎn yuán jiě shì bái tiān fú wù hé wǎn jiān huó dòng de rén yuán ān pái bù tóng , suí hòu bǎ jiè shū shí jiān jiā dào rù kǒu de zhǐ shàng , yě fàng jìn bào míng huí fù lǐ . dì èr cì réng yǒu yī gè rén kàn lòu le , dàn tā jìn mén jiù wèn qīng , jué dìng xiān liú xià tīng , xià zhōu bái tiān zài lái bàn lǐ . xiū gǎi yī zhāng tōng zhī méi ràng wèn tí mǎ shàng xiāo shī , què jiǎn shǎo le bǎ qī dài yī lù dài dào sàn chǎng cái luò kōng de qíng kuàng .
lines.en: The first notice didn't make that clear. A visitor arrived with book titles to borrow, learning after discussion that lending had closed. Staff explained the separate arrangements and added lending hours to the entrance and registration reply. Someone missed it the next week but asked on arrival, chose to listen and planned a daytime return. A changed notice didn't erase every problem, but reduced disappointment discovered only at the end.

lines.zh: 晚间开放也把收尾的工作带到了大家眼前。平时六点停止借书，工作人员六点半收完；活动那晚读者八点离开，两名工作人员还要把椅子收回、检查热水设备、关好门窗，到八点半才结束。每人比平时多值班两个小时，四次合起来是十六个人小时，每人八小时。读者可以帮忙排椅子，设备和门窗仍由工作人员检查。最后一次收完，馆员把四晚的值班表摊在桌上，说下个月要是继续，还得先问这两个人有没有时间。发起活动的读者拿出手机，约好第二天再来一起看安排。
lines.py: wǎn jiān kāi fàng yě bǎ shōu wěi de gōng zuò dài dào le dà jiā yǎn qián . píng shí liù diǎn tíng zhǐ jiè shū , gōng zuò rén yuán liù diǎn bàn shōu wán ; huó dòng nà wǎn dú zhě bā diǎn lí kāi , liǎng míng gōng zuò rén yuán hái yào bǎ yǐ zi shōu huí , jiǎn chá rè shuǐ shè bèi , guān hǎo mén chuāng , dào bā diǎn bàn cái jié shù . měi rén bǐ píng shí duō zhí bān liǎng gè xiǎo shí , sì cì hé qǐ lái shì shí liù gè rén xiǎo shí , měi rén bā xiǎo shí . dú zhě kě yǐ bāng máng pái yǐ zi , shè bèi hé mén chuāng réng yóu gōng zuò rén yuán jiǎn chá . zuì hòu yī cì shōu wán , guǎn yuán bǎ sì wǎn de zhí bān biǎo tān zài zhuō shàng , shuō xià gè yuè yào shì jì xù , hái děi xiān wèn zhè liǎng gè rén yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān . fā qǐ huó dòng de dú zhě ná chū shǒu jī , yuē hǎo dì èr tiān zài lái yì qǐ kàn ān pái .
lines.en: Evening events made closing duties visible. Lending normally ended at six and staff finished at 6:30. On event nights readers left at eight; two staff put chairs away, checked the hot-water equipment and closed the windows and doors until 8:30. Each worked two extra hours per event: sixteen staff-hours over four evenings, or eight extra hours each. Readers helped with chairs, while staff checked equipment and doors. After the final evening, the librarian spread out the duty rota: continuing next month would first depend on those two people's availability. The organisers arranged to return the next day to look at the schedule together.

lines.zh: 最后一次结束，发起活动的读者在门口碰到那个曾想借书的人。他这回带来的书已经白天借好，还把朋友一起叫来。两人坐得不算前，听到有人读一段关于离家的文字时，互相看了一眼。散场以后，他们没有说自己从此都会来，只问下个月还有没有安排。馆员说还在商量，确定了就发通知。夜晚留给读者的，不是一个已经答应永远开放的门，而是四次实在的相遇，以及能继续商量下一次的机会。
lines.py: zuì hòu yī cì jié shù , fā qǐ huó dòng de dú zhě zài mén kǒu pèng dào nà gè céng xiǎng jiè shū de rén . tā zhè huí dài lái de shū yǐ jīng bái tiān jiè hǎo , hái bǎ péng you yì qǐ jiào lái . liǎng rén zuò de bù suàn qián , tīng dào yǒu rén dú yī duàn guān yú lí jiā de wén zì shí , hù xiāng kàn le yī yǎn . sàn chǎng yǐ hòu , tā men méi yǒu shuō zì jǐ cóng cǐ dū huì lái , zhǐ wèn xià gè yuè hái yǒu méi yǒu ān pái . guǎn yuán shuō hái zài shāng liáng , què dìng le jiù fā tōng zhī . yè wǎn liú gěi dú zhě de , bù shì yī gè yǐ jīng dā yìng yǒng yuǎn kāi fàng de mén , ér shì sì cì shí zài de xiāng yù , yǐ jí néng jì xù shāng liáng xià yī cì de jī huì .
lines.en: At the final event the would-be borrower returned with a book borrowed during daytime and a friend. During a passage about leaving home they glanced at each other. Afterwards they didn't promise permanent attendance, only asked about next month. Staff were still discussing it and would notify people once settled. The trial offered four real encounters and a chance to discuss another, not a promise of a permanently open door.

lines.py: wài guān biàn xīn bù biǎo shì jiè shū fāng shì yě biàn le .
lines.en: A new appearance doesn't mean borrowing procedures changed.

lines.zh: 我喜欢这张桌子的外观。
lines.py: wǒ xǐ huān zhè zhāng zhuō zi de wài guān .
lines.en: I like the appearance of this table.

lines.zh: 本地杂志采访了图书馆工作人员。
lines.py: běn dì zá zhì cǎi fǎng le tú shū guǎn gōng zuò rén yuán .
lines.en: A local magazine interviewed library staff.

lines.zh: 她想认识一些本地朋友。
lines.py: tā xiǎng rèn shi yī xiē běn dì péng you .
lines.en: She wants to meet some local friends.

lines.zh: 前来活动的人也有只听不借书的。
lines.py: qián lái huó dòng de rén yě yǒu zhǐ tīng bù jiè shū de .
lines.en: Some event visitors listen without borrowing.

lines.zh: 他前来领取自己的资料。
lines.py: tā qián lái lǐng qǔ zì jǐ de zī liào .
lines.en: He came to collect his materials.

lines.zh: 此处登记活动，不办理借书。
lines.py: cǐ chù dēng jì huó dòng , bù bàn lǐ jiè shū .
lines.en: Event registration happens here, not book borrowing.

lines.zh: 此处暂时不能停车。
lines.py: cǐ chù zàn shí bù néng tíng chē .
lines.en: Parking here is temporarily prohibited.

lines.zh: 截至月底，共有六十四次到访。
lines.py: jié zhì yuè dǐ , gòng yǒu liù shí sì cì dào fǎng .
lines.en: By month's end there were sixty-four visits.

lines.zh: 截至周五，名额还没有满。
lines.py: jié zhì zhōu wǔ , míng é hái méi yǒu mǎn .
lines.en: As of Friday the places weren't full.

lines.zh: 工作人员在门口发放节目单。
lines.py: gōng zuò rén yuán zài mén kǒu fā fàng jié mù dān .
lines.en: Staff hand out programmes at the entrance.

lines.zh: 资料明天统一发放。
lines.py: zī liào míng tiān tǒng yī fā fàng .
lines.en: The materials will be distributed tomorrow.

lines.zh: 两个读者发起了晚间读书活动。
lines.py: liǎng gè dú zhě fā qǐ le wǎn jiān dú shū huó dòng .
lines.en: Two readers initiated the evening reading event.

lines.zh: 她发起了一个小范围的讨论。
lines.py: tā fā qǐ le yī gè xiǎo fàn wéi de tǎo lùn .
lines.en: She started a small discussion.

lines.zh: 想带作品的人先提交一段介绍。
lines.py: xiǎng dài zuò pǐn de rén xiān tí jiāo yī duàn jiè shào .
lines.en: People bringing work first submit a short introduction.

lines.zh: 他按时提交了申请。
lines.py: tā àn shí tí jiāo le shēn qǐng .
lines.en: He submitted the application on time.

lines.zh: 馆员向报名的人通报时间调整。
lines.py: guǎn yuán xiàng bào míng de rén tōng bào shí jiān tiáo zhěng .
lines.en: The librarian told registrants about the time change.

lines.zh: 小组通报了活动结果。
lines.py: xiǎo zǔ tōng bào le huó dòng jié guǒ .
lines.en: The group announced the event results.

lines.zh: 场馆平日六点关门。
lines.py: chǎng guǎn píng rì liù diǎn guān mén .
lines.en: The venue normally closes at six.

lines.zh: 那个场馆就在车站旁。
lines.py: nà gè chǎng guǎn jiù zài chē zhàn páng .
lines.en: That venue is beside the station.

lines.zh: 夜间活动只用一楼场地。
lines.py: yè jiān huó dòng zhǐ yòng yī lóu chǎng dì .
lines.en: The evening event uses only the downstairs space.

lines.zh: 活动临时换了场地。
lines.py: huó dòng lín shí huàn le chǎng dì .
lines.en: The event changed location at short notice.

lines.zh: 周末讲座有二十个名额。
lines.py: zhōu mò jiǎng zuò yǒu èr shí gè míng é .
lines.en: The weekend talk has twenty places.

lines.zh: 我想问还有没有名额。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn hái yǒu méi yǒu míng é .
lines.en: I'd like to ask whether any places remain.

lines.zh: 常规借书时间没有延长。
lines.py: cháng guī jiè shū shí jiān méi yǒu yán cháng .
lines.en: Normal borrowing hours have not been extended.

lines.zh: 这是常规安排的一部分。
lines.py: zhè shì cháng guī ān pái de yī bù fèn .
lines.en: This is part of the usual arrangement.

lines.zh: 夜间开放先试点四周。
lines.py: yè jiān kāi fàng xiān shì diǎn sì zhōu .
lines.en: Evening opening is initially a four-week pilot.

lines.zh: 试点结束后再听取意见。
lines.py: shì diǎn jié shù hòu zài tīng qǔ yì jiàn .
lines.en: Hear feedback after the pilot ends.

lines.zh: 错开收尾时间是一个切实的改进。
lines.py: cuò kāi shōu wěi shí jiān shì yī gè qiè shí de gǎi jìn .
lines.en: Separating closing duties is a practical improvement.

lines.zh: 她想找到切实的办法。
lines.py: tā xiǎng zhǎo dào qiè shí de bàn fǎ .
lines.en: She wants to find a workable solution.

lines.zh: 能否继续开放，还得看人员安排。
lines.py: néng fǒu jì xù kāi fàng , hái děi kàn rén yuán ān pái .
lines.en: Continued opening depends on staffing.

lines.zh: 能否带朋友参加，请先确认。
lines.py: néng fǒu dài péng you cān jiā , qǐng xiān què rèn .
lines.en: Please confirm whether a friend can join.

lines.zh: 附近演出也是到访增加的因素。
lines.py: fù jìn yǎn chū yě shì dào fǎng zēng jiā de yīn sù .
lines.en: A nearby performance also contributed to visits.

lines.zh: 她考虑了几个不同因素。
lines.py: tā kǎo lǜ le jǐ gè bù tóng yīn sù .
lines.en: She considered several different factors.

lines.zh: 这两件事有关联，文章却没有说谁造成谁。
lines.py: zhè liǎng jiàn shì yǒu guān lián , wén zhāng què méi yǒu shuō shéi zào chéng shéi .
lines.en: The two are connected, but the article doesn't state which caused which.

lines.zh: 这张图和正文有什么关联？
lines.py: zhè zhāng tú hé zhèng wén yǒu shén me guān lián ?
lines.en: How does this picture relate to the text?

lines.zh: 文章的核心是一次有条件的尝试。
lines.py: wén zhāng de hé xīn shì yī cì yǒu tiáo jiàn de cháng shì .
lines.en: The article centres on a trial with conditions.

lines.zh: 先说核心问题，细节以后补。
lines.py: xiān shuō hé xīn wèn tí , xì jié yǐ hòu bǔ .
lines.en: Start with the central issue and add details later.

lines.zh: 两份材料的差异主要在关注的事。
lines.py: liǎng fèn cái liào de chā yì zhǔ yào zài guān zhù de shì .
lines.en: The materials chiefly differ in what they focus on.

lines.zh: 数字的差异需要解释。
lines.py: shù zì de chā yì xū yào jiě shì .
lines.en: The numerical difference needs explanation.

lines.zh: 据值班记录，六十四是到访次数。
lines.py: jù zhí bān jì lù , liù shí sì shì dào fǎng cì shù .
lines.en: According to the duty record, sixty-four counts visits.

lines.zh: 据通知，周四只开放一楼。
lines.py: jù tōng zhī , zhōu sì zhǐ kāi fàng yī lóu .
lines.en: According to the notice, only downstairs opens on Thursday.

lines.zh: 至于借书，还是白天办理。
lines.py: zhì yú jiè shū , hái shi bái tiān bàn lǐ .
lines.en: Borrowing is still handled during the day.

lines.zh: 至于下个月的安排，还没确定。
lines.py: zhì yú xià gè yuè de ān pái , hái méi què dìng .
lines.en: Next month's arrangements are undecided.

lines.zh: 最终决定要等试点结束。
lines.py: zuì zhōng jué dìng yào děng shì diǎn jié shù .
lines.en: The final decision will wait until the pilot ends.

lines.zh: 他们最终选了小房间。
lines.py: tā men zuì zhōng xuǎn le xiǎo fáng jiān .
lines.en: They finally chose the small room.

lines.zh: 忘了带卡，她只得白天再来借书。
lines.py: wàng le dài kǎ , tā zhǐ dé bái tiān zài lái jiè shū .
lines.en: Having forgotten her card, she had to return in daytime to borrow.

lines.zh: 雨太大，我们只得换到室内。
lines.py: yǔ tài dà , wǒ men zhǐ dé huàn dào shì nèi .
lines.en: The heavy rain left us no choice but to move indoors.

lines.zh: 把借书时间写上，免得读者白跑。
lines.py: bǎ jiè shū shí jiān xiě shàng , miǎn de dú zhě bái pǎo .
lines.en: Include borrowing hours so readers don't make a wasted trip.

lines.zh: 先确认地点，免得走错。
lines.py: xiān què rèn dì diǎn , miǎn de zǒu cuò .
lines.en: Confirm the venue first to avoid going to the wrong place.

lines.zh: 馆员先听取到访者的意见。
lines.py: guǎn yuán xiān tīng qǔ dào fǎng zhě de yì jiàn .
lines.en: The librarian first hears visitors' views.

lines.zh: 小组会听取不同意见。
lines.py: xiǎo zǔ huì tīng qǔ bù tóng yì jiàn .
lines.en: The group will hear differing views.

extraReadings.title: This week’s registration notice
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 本周图书馆有两项活动，请报名时留意日期、时间和地点。周四是晚间读书活动，六点半入场，七点开始，八点结束，活动区域为一楼小厅。周六是作者见面会，下午一点半入场，两点开始，三点结束，地点也是一楼小厅。两项活动需要分别报名，周四的回复不能代替周六报名。由于地方有限，两场各有二十个名额，额满后可以留下联系方式，若有人退出，工作人员会按登记顺序联系。
lines.py: běn zhōu tú shū guǎn yǒu liǎng xiàng huó dòng , qǐng bào míng shí liú yì rì qī , shí jiān hé dì diǎn . zhōu sì shì wǎn jiān dú shū huó dòng , liù diǎn bàn rù chǎng , qī diǎn kāi shǐ , bā diǎn jié shù , huó dòng qū yù wèi yī lóu xiǎo tīng . zhōu liù shì zuò zhě jiàn miàn huì , xià wǔ yī diǎn bàn rù chǎng , liǎng diǎn kāi shǐ , sān diǎn jié shù , dì diǎn yě shì yī lóu xiǎo tīng . liǎng xiàng huó dòng xū yào fēn bié bào míng , zhōu sì de huí fù bù néng dài tì zhōu liù bào míng . yóu yú dì fāng yǒu xiàn , liǎng chǎng gè yǒu èr shí gè míng é , é mǎn hòu kě yǐ liú xià lián xì fāng shì , ruò yǒu rén tuì chū , gōng zuò rén yuán huì àn dēng jì shùn xù lián xì .
lines.en: Two library events require attention to dates, times and locations. Thursday reading admits at6:30,starts7,ends8 in the ground-floor room. Saturday's author meeting admits1:30,starts2,ends3 there. Register separately; Thursday confirmation doesn't cover Saturday. Each has twenty places. A waiting list will be contacted in registration order if places open.

lines.zh: 周四活动属于晚间开放试点，本月一共安排四次。试点只开放一楼小厅和入口通道，二楼及其他区域不开放。常规借书、还书办理时间仍到下午六点，晚间活动不提供借书服务。若您计划借书，请在常规开放时间前来；参加晚间活动时，可以带自己的书，也可以按活动安排听别人介绍。请把借阅办理与活动报名分别安排，以免到场后错过白天的柜台服务。
lines.py: zhōu sì huó dòng shǔ yú wǎn jiān kāi fàng shì diǎn , běn yuè yī gòng ān pái sì cì . shì diǎn zhǐ kāi fàng yī lóu xiǎo tīng hé rù kǒu tōng dào , èr lóu jí qí tā qū yù bù kāi fàng . cháng guī jiè shū , huán shū bàn lǐ shí jiān réng dào xià wǔ liù diǎn , wǎn jiān huó dòng bù tí gōng jiè shū fú wù . ruò nín jì huà jiè shū , qǐng zài cháng guī kāi fàng shí jiān qián lái ; cān jiā wǎn jiān huó dòng shí , kě yǐ dài zì jǐ de shū , yě kě yǐ àn huó dòng ān pái tīng bié ren jiè shào . qǐng bǎ jiè yuè bàn lǐ yǔ huó dòng bào míng fēn bié ān pái , yǐ miǎn dào chǎng hòu cuò guò bái tiān de guì tái fú wù .
lines.en: There are four Thursday evening pilot events this month, limited to the first-floor small hall and entrance passage. Other areas are closed. Regular loans and returns end at six; evening events offer no borrowing service. Visit during regular hours to borrow. At the event, bring your own book or listen to introductions. Arrange borrowing and event registration separately so you don't miss the daytime counter.

lines.zh: 参加周四读书活动，可以带一本自己的书，也可以只听。想分享的人，请在周三晚八点前提交书名和一段简短介绍，现场每人先读不超过三分钟，再留时间交流。不想发言的读者无需提交介绍，报名回复里写只听即可。若已经提交而临时不方便分享，请告诉工作人员，不会因此取消您的参加资格。读者可以选择怎么参与，组织者需要提前知道分享人数，才能把结束时间安排得清楚。
lines.py: cān jiā zhōu sì dú shū huó dòng , kě yǐ dài yī běn zì jǐ de shū , yě kě yǐ zhǐ tīng . xiǎng fēn xiǎng de rén , qǐng zài zhōu sān wǎn bā diǎn qián tí jiāo shū míng hé yī duàn jiǎn duǎn jiè shào , xiàn chǎng měi rén xiān dú bù chāo guò sān fēn zhōng , zài liú shí jiān jiāo liú . bù xiǎng fā yán de dú zhě wú xū tí jiāo jiè shào , bào míng huí fù lǐ xiě zhǐ tīng jí kě . ruò yǐ jīng tí jiāo ér lín shí bù fāng biàn fēn xiǎng , qǐng gào sù gōng zuò rén yuán , bù huì yīn cǐ qǔ xiāo nín de cān jiā zī gé . dú zhě kě yǐ xuǎn zé zěn me cān yù , zǔ zhī zhě xū yào tí qián zhī dào fēn xiǎng rén shù , cái néng bǎ jié shù shí jiān ān pái de qīng chǔ .
lines.en: For Thursday, bring a book or just listen. Speakers submit a title and short introduction by Wednesday8pm. Each initially reads no more than three minutes, followed by conversation. Listeners needn't submit an introduction; say 'listen only' in registration. If a planned speaker withdraws from speaking, notify staff; attendance isn't cancelled. Participation is optional; knowing speaker numbers helps plan the finish.

lines.zh: 周六作者见面会不要求事先准备介绍。想问作者的问题可以在报名时提交，也可以活动现场写在纸上交给工作人员。主持人会选取与作品相关的问题，不保证每一条都在现场回答。活动结束后有十分钟签名时间，只供已报名的参加者，不另开放入场。签名时请按照工作人员安排排队，不要因为想多聊一会儿占据后面读者的时间。有关下一次活动的信息会另行通知，作者当天也不能替图书馆确认还没决定的日期。
lines.py: zhōu liù zuò zhě jiàn miàn huì bú yào qiú shì xiān zhǔn bèi jiè shào . xiǎng wèn zuò zhě de wèn tí kě yǐ zài bào míng shí tí jiāo , yě kě yǐ huó dòng xiàn chǎng xiě zài zhǐ shàng jiāo gěi gōng zuò rén yuán . zhǔ chí rén huì xuǎn qǔ yǔ zuò pǐn xiāng guān de wèn tí , bù bǎo zhèng měi yī tiáo dōu zài xiàn chǎng huí dá . huó dòng jié shù hòu yǒu shí fēn zhōng qiān míng shí jiān , zhǐ gōng yǐ bào míng de cān jiā zhě , bù lìng kāi fàng rù chǎng . qiān míng shí qǐng àn zhào gōng zuò rén yuán ān pái pái duì , bú yào yīn wèi xiǎng duō liáo yī huì er zhàn jù hòu miàn dú zhě de shí jiān . yǒu guān xià yī cì huó dòng de xìn xī huì lìng xíng tōng zhī , zuò zhě dàng tiān yě bù néng tì tú shū guǎn què rèn hái méi jué dìng de rì qī .
lines.en: Saturday needs no prepared introduction. Submit questions during registration or on paper at the event. The host selects work-related questions; not all are guaranteed an answer. Ten minutes for signing follow for registered attendees only. Queue as directed; longer personal conversation takes others' time. Future dates will be announced separately; the author cannot confirm undecided library arrangements.

lines.zh: 两项活动都请提前十分钟到场核对报名信息。周四八点结束后，工作人员需要检查设备并整理场地，到八点半关闭。读者愿意帮助排椅子，可以在活动结束后问工作人员，不要自行收起仍在使用的设备。周六签名结束后也请按通知离场。提前结束讨论是为了留出实际工作时间，不表示读者可以一直留到关门前一刻。若需要无障碍座位或有其他实际需要，请报名时说明，工作人员会按现有条件回复，不会只凭一句需求就保证所有安排都能做到。
lines.py: liǎng xiàng huó dòng dōu qǐng tí qián shí fēn zhōng dào chǎng hé duì bào míng xìn xī . zhōu sì bā diǎn jié shù hòu , gōng zuò rén yuán xū yào jiǎn chá shè bèi bìng zhěng lǐ chǎng dì , dào bā diǎn bàn guān bì . dú zhě yuàn yì bāng zhù pái yǐ zi , kě yǐ zài huó dòng jié shù hòu wèn gōng zuò rén yuán , bú yào zì xíng shōu qǐ réng zài shǐ yòng de shè bèi . zhōu liù qiān míng jié shù hòu yě qǐng àn tōng zhī lí chǎng . tí qián jié shù tǎo lùn shì wèi le liú chū shí jì gōng zuò shí jiān , bù biǎo shì dú zhě kě yǐ yì zhí liú dào guān mén qián yī kè . ruò xū yào wú zhàng ài zuò wèi huò yǒu qí tā shí jì xū yào , qǐng bào míng shí shuō míng , gōng zuò rén yuán huì àn xiàn yǒu tiáo jiàn huí fù , bù huì zhǐ píng yī jù xū qiú jiù bǎo zhèng suǒ yǒu ān pái dōu néng zuò dào .
lines.en: Arrive ten minutes early to check registration. Thursday ends8; staff inspect and restore the room before8:30closure. Ask before helping; don't put away equipment still in use. Leave after Saturday signing too. Closing time includes work, not permission to remain until the last moment. State accessibility or other needs when registering; staff will reply based on available arrangements rather than guarantee every request.

lines.zh: 如需取消报名，请尽早回复确认消息，让等候的人有机会参加。不要把朋友带入而不另行登记，尤其不要把一场已经确认的名额转到另一场。通知里所说的二十个名额是参加者座位，现场工作人员另有工作位置，不占这二十个座位。试点结束后，图书馆会听取读者和工作人员的意见，再决定是否继续。请以正式通知为准；杂志里的采访帮助您了解这次尝试的故事，不能代替本周两场活动的报名确认和日期说明。

audio.zh: 四次活动结束，到访记录分别是十八、二十、十二和十四次，共六十四次。这里记录的是每次走进活动区的人次，不是去掉重复以后的六十四位居民。前两次正好遇到附近有演出，有几个人听一小段就离开；第三次下雨，也有人提前发消息说不方便来。组织者没有把每一种变化都归到读书内容上。大家更关心留下的人能不能听清、椅子够不够，以及八点结束时还有没有人临时才知道不能借书。

audio.en: The four visit counts were eighteen, twenty, twelve and fourteen, totalling sixty-four visits rather than sixty-four unique residents. The first two coincided with nearby performances; some left shortly. Rain affected the third. Organisers didn't assign every change to reading content. They cared about audibility, seating and whether anyone learned only at eight that lending was unavailable.

audio.zh: 晚间开放也把收尾的工作带到了大家眼前。平时六点停止借书，工作人员六点半收完；活动那晚读者八点离开，两名工作人员还要把椅子收回、检查热水设备、关好门窗，到八点半才结束。每人比平时多值班两个小时，四次合起来是十六个人小时，每人八小时。读者可以帮忙排椅子，设备和门窗仍由工作人员检查。最后一次收完，馆员把四晚的值班表摊在桌上，说下个月要是继续，还得先问这两个人有没有时间。发起活动的读者拿出手机，约好第二天再来一起看安排。
audio.py: wǎn jiān kāi fàng yě bǎ shōu wěi de gōng zuò dài dào le dà jiā yǎn qián . píng shí liù diǎn tíng zhǐ jiè shū , gōng zuò rén yuán liù diǎn bàn shōu wán ; huó dòng nà wǎn dú zhě bā diǎn lí kāi , liǎng míng gōng zuò rén yuán hái yào bǎ yǐ zi shōu huí , jiǎn chá rè shuǐ shè bèi , guān hǎo mén chuāng , dào bā diǎn bàn cái jié shù . měi rén bǐ píng shí duō zhí bān liǎng gè xiǎo shí , sì cì hé qǐ lái shì shí liù gè rén xiǎo shí , měi rén bā xiǎo shí . dú zhě kě yǐ bāng máng pái yǐ zi , shè bèi hé mén chuāng réng yóu gōng zuò rén yuán jiǎn chá . zuì hòu yī cì shōu wán , guǎn yuán bǎ sì wǎn de zhí bān biǎo tān zài zhuō shàng , shuō xià gè yuè yào shì jì xù , hái děi xiān wèn zhè liǎng gè rén yǒu méi yǒu shí jiān . fā qǐ huó dòng de dú zhě ná chū shǒu jī , yuē hǎo dì èr tiān zài lái yì qǐ kàn ān pái .
audio.en: Evening events made closing duties visible. Lending normally ended at six and staff finished at 6:30. On event nights readers left at eight; two staff put chairs away, checked the hot-water equipment and closed the windows and doors until 8:30. Each worked two extra hours per event: sixteen staff-hours over four evenings, or eight extra hours each. Readers helped with chairs, while staff checked equipment and doors. After the final evening, the librarian spread out the duty rota: continuing next month would first depend on those two people's availability. The organisers arranged to return the next day to look at the schedule together.
